name: IRAS 13120-5453 (Webb)
blurb: IRAS 13120-5453, an ultraluminous infrared galaxy, seen by Webb.
label: ir13120-webb
story: A galaxy in the aftermath of a merger, with a single nucleus and a compact burst of star birth at its core. An active galactic nucleus and winds may also stir the gas at its heart.

claims.text: IRAS 13120-5453 is a single-nucleus ultraluminous infrared galaxy
It is classified as a post-merger system
An active galactic nucleus and winds may contribute to heating
Archive target IR13120 is at the position of IRAS 13120-5453
IR13120 is a target of the JWST ULIRG survey (program 3368), described as infrared and interacting galaxies
